classes.title: Ручной пересчёт
prompts: A bank cashier counting banknotes by hand at a desk.
A cashier flipping through a stack of cash with her fingers.

classes.title: Счётная машинка
prompts: A bank cashier using a banknote counting machine.
A cashier feeding cash into a money counting machine at a desk.

classes.title: Работа за ноутбуком
prompts: A bank cashier typing on a laptop computer at a desk.
A cashier entering information using a laptop keyboard.

classes.title: Работа с документом
prompts: A bank cashier holding and inspecting a customer's identity card.
A cashier receiving and examining an identification document.

classes.title: Работа с сейфом
prompts: A bank cashier opening, closing or locking a safe beside a desk.
A cashier reaching into a safe to put away or take out cash.

classes.title: Уход кассира
prompts: A bank cashier standing up and walking away from her workstation to the door.
A cashier leaving the cash office through a glass door.
